name: flexiclaw-codex-plugin
description: Observability investigation skills for Codex using Elastic.

interface.shortDescription: Investigate Elastic observability data from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Flexiclaw for Elastic helps users connect Elastic in Codex, then adds observability-first investigation skills for logs, APM traces, metrics and streams. It can guide ES|QL generation, dashboard proposals and evidence-based reports. The MVP is read-only by default.
defaultPrompt: Create a dashboard preview for the last 30 days.
